rca of the issue: Accounting user in DB has stored permissions from an earlier seed run when server.py DEFAULT_PERMS_BY_ROLE.accounting did NOT include product.view. The default was later updated (server.py:57) but seed_users is not idempotent for permissions on existing users, so the accounting document's persisted permissions never got product.view. Frontend ROUTE_PERMS at nav.js:12 maps /products -> product.view (single perm), and App.js wraps /products in RequirePermission perm='product.view'. Because the user's perm list lacks product.view, the guard renders <Forbidden/> even though backend GET /api/packages accepts hpp.view (which the user has). Reproduction: login as accounting -> click 'Packages' in sidebar -> 403 page. Mitigation (either or both): (a) modify seed/init to upsert missing default perms on existing users, or add an admin migration script; (b) refactor RequirePermission to accept an array of perms and pass ['product.view','hpp.view'] on /products and /products/:id (mirrors backend require_any_permission).
